definitions.gloss: to go to school; to attend school
definitions.explanation: To go to school for the day's classes, specifically the act of traveling to and arriving at school. Used for regular school attendance.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}8{時|じ}に{登校|とうこう}する。
examples.english: I go to school at 8 o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}で{登校|とうこう}が{困難|こんなん}になった。
examples.english: The snow made it difficult to get to school.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{元気|げんき}に{登校|とうこう}する{姿|すがた}を{見|み}ると、{朝|あさ}から{気持|きも}ちがよくなる。
examples.english: Seeing children cheerfully heading to school brightens my morning.

notes: Common collocations: {登校|とうこう}{時間|じかん} (time to go to school), {登校|とうこう}{拒否|きょひ} (school refusal — a recognized social issue in Japan), {登校|とうこう}{班|はん} (walking group for going to school), {登校|とうこう}{日|び} (school day). The opposite is {下校|げこう} (leaving school for home). Pairs with {登校|とうこう}/{下校|げこう} just as {出勤|しゅっきん}/{退勤|たいきん} pair for going to and leaving work. Related: {通学|つうがく} (commuting to school — emphasizes the regular pattern of attendance).
